independent_mathematical_checks: For the Levi construction, bar-d(g/W)=(bar-d g)/W is smooth because bar-d g vanishes near the only zero of W; the singular holomorphic function is h=u-g/W.
At degree q=0 a nonzero holomorphic function has Q=0 and nonzero boundary norm, so the displayed unrestricted boundary estimate cannot hold.
For the paraboloid z=r^2, K=4/(1+4r^2)^2 and dA=r sqrt(1+4r^2) dr dtheta; integration gives 2pi.
The algebraic principal-symbol convention P(f^m s)(x) includes m!, explaining the factor 2 for the Laplacian.
The graded product rule gives d(fs)=df wedge s at f=0, and the Koszul contraction identity with a vector pairing to 1 proves symbol exactness.
The Laplacian eigenspace contraction h=d*/lambda is valid for positive lambda. In contrast ker(Box-lambda) is the eigenspace itself and cannot equal its zero cohomology.
Spectral projections commute with d, so compressed maps pi_lambda T i_lambda are chain maps even if T and Box do not commute.
The finite-complex trace proof uses a preserved filtration by boundaries and cycles; invariant complements are unnecessary.
For the circle with periodic L2 metric, (d/dt)*=-d/dt and Box=-d2/dt2.
The delta substitution uses the absolute determinant of I-df, not an unweighted point count.
The exterior-power alternating trace is det(I-A); realification gives trace_R=2 Re trace_C and det_R=|det_C|^2.
The classical affine coordinate ring requires the radical ideal; x^2=0 versus x=0 checks the omitted hypothesis.
The punctured-plane section ring is k[x,y]_x intersection k[x,y]_y=k[x,y], proving nonaffineness by the canonical affine-spectrum map.
The diagonal is dense in the product of two infinite cofinite topologies but closed in the affine-plane Zariski topology; the doubled-origin diagonal is not closed.
In A=k[x1,x2,...]/(x1*xj:j>=2), ann(x1)=(x2,x3,...) is not finitely generated, although A has its one-generator trivial presentation.
Allowing all projectives in K0 gives Q=P+Q for a countable direct sum and collapses the group; finite generation is indispensable.
For dual numbers A=k[epsilon]/epsilon^2, projectives are free and finite modules have length; the Cartan map K0(A)->G0(A) is multiplication by 2.
Without normalization, every nonzero positive-definite function is the midpoint of 0 and twice itself and is not an extreme point.
The derived connecting morphism has source R^iF(C) and target R^(i+1)F(A); covariance fixes the corrected naturality-square direction.
